nsnotice.body:
Northstar (NS / NSEN) is the international client. NorthStarCN (NSCN) is the Chinese localized client.

These clients are not interchangeable. Installing the international Northstar package from the mod browser over a NorthStarCN installation can prevent it from starting. Only replace it if you intend to switch clients.
